scene_summary: A dark framed architectural plate: a massive ribbed concrete slab cuts diagonally across a cold sky pocket, held by vertical pillars and a lower procession wall. The visible source-bearing marks are mostly real seams, slits, punctures, rib bands, and structural notches rather than UI cards.
usable_surfaces: upper scratch veil on slab underside
small puncture cluster in central cutaway

detected_objects.label: governing diagonal slab cut
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The broad concrete underside forms the dominant diagonal cut, with ribbed surface texture and a hard lower edge crossing from upper left toward the right support zone.

detected_objects.label: lower walking pressure ridge
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A long ribbed horizontal band runs across the lower wall; its repeated vertical teeth and stained concrete edge make a distinct pressure seam.

detected_objects.visual_evidence: A long broken pale diagonal slit appears in the right underside of the slab, reading as sky/light leaking through a narrow dropout.

detected_objects.label: cutaway puncture cluster
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A compact cluster of dark punctures and chipped nodes is visible in the central underside of the slab, nested around small broken marks.

detected_objects.visual_evidence: A distant vertical interruption between right-side supports cuts into the pale sky pocket beneath the slab.

complexity_assessment.rationale: The plate is sparse and expressionist: one dominant diagonal slab, one lower ridge, a few vertical supports, and small slits/punctures. The barcode-like header adds graphic noise, but the mapped architectural marks remain clear and not visually cluttered.

mapping_note: Package assembly filled unmapped source pockets from planned artifact surfaces because plate inspection returned too few detected objects.
